name: io.github.Mira-AI-Tools/mira
title: Video Transcript MCP for TikTok, Instagram Reels & YouTube — Mira
description: Transcribe TikTok, Instagram Reels & YouTube videos: transcript, on-screen text, extract, download.

tools.name: parse_video
tools.description: Watch a TikTok, Instagram Reel, YouTube Short/video, Pinterest, Facebook or X video link (or a web page) and return its transcript, on-screen text, caption and a structured extract. On the Extract + Video plan it also returns a download link for the original video (every file of a carousel). If the result isn't ready yet, returns a job_id.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Get the extract of a video that was still processing, by its job_id.

job_id.description: The job_id of the video being processed

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the Mira plan, today's usage and a link to manage or cancel the subscription.
